amplificationDate.description: Date when the amplification was carried out

amplificationStaff.description: Person or Institution who performed the amplification

amplificationSuccess.description: true/false or yes/no whether the ampliciation was successful in general; highly recommended to report unsuccessful runs

amplificationSuccessDetails.description: Details about the amplification, e.g. including why it has failed

barcodeSequence.description: DNA Barcode sequence (part or 100% of the consensus sequence)

BOLDProcessID.description: Definite number or ID under which the DNA sequence is deposited in the BOLD database

consensusSequence.description: Consensus sequence derived from all individual sequences

consensusSequenceChromatogramFileURI.description: Link to the chromatogram of the consensus sequence

consensusSequenceLength.description: Length of the consensus sequence (number of base pairs)

geneticAccessionNumber.description: Definite number or ID under which the DNA sequence is deposited in a public database (GenBank/EMBL/DDBJ accession number)

geneticAccessionURI.description: URI of the related record in a public database (GenBank/DDBJ/EMBL record)

marker.description: Genetic locus/marker or DNA fragment amplified by PCR

markerAccordance.description: Result of comparison of two markers of two specimens or strains. Name or TAX-ID (NCBI) of compared specimens/strain and the relative identity percentage must be given

markerSubfragment.description: Name of subfragment of a gene or locus. Important to e.g. identify special regions on marker genes

primerName.description: Name of primer used for this amplification, cloning, or single read

primerNameForward.description: Name of primer used for this amplification, cloning, or single read

primerNameReverse.description: Name of reverse primer used for this amplification, cloning, or single read

primerReferenceCitationForward.description: First reference of the forward rimer

primerReferenceCitationReverse.description: First reference of the reverse primer

primerReferenceLink.description: Link to the first reference of the primer

primerReferenceLinkForward.description: Link to the first reference of the primer

primerReferenceLinkReverse.description: Link to the first reference of the primer

primerSequence.description: DNA sequence of the primer (A,T,G,C; 5' to 3')

primerSequenceForward.description: DNA sequence of the forward primer (A,T,G,C; 5' to 3')

primerSequenceReverse.description: DNA sequence of the reverse primer (A,T,G,C; 5' to 3')

purificationMethod.description: Method or protocol used for secundary purification of already extracted genomic DNA or of PCR product

adapters.description: Adapters provide priming sequences for both amplification and sequencing of the sample-library fragments. Both adapters should be reported; in uppercase letters

annot source.description: For cases where annotation was provided by a community jamboree or model organism database rather than by a specific submitter

assembly.description: How was the assembly done (e.g. with a text based assembler like phrap or a flowgram assembler); estimated error rate associated with the finished sequences (e.g. error rate of 1 in 1000 bp); and the method of calculation

chimera check.description: A chimeric sequence, or chimera for short, is a sequence comprised of two or more phylogenetically distinct parent sequences. Chimeras are usually PCR artifacts thought to occur when a prematurely terminated amplicon reanneals to a foreign DNA strand and is copied to completion in the following PCR cycles. The point at which the chimeric sequence changes from one parent to the next is called the breakpoint or conversion point

finishing strategy.description: Was the genome project intended to produce a complete or draft genome, Coverage, the fold coverage of the sequencing expressed as 2x, 3x, 18x etc, and how many contigs were produced for the genome

mid.description: Molecular barcodes, called Multiplex Identifiers (MIDs), that are used to specifically tag unique samples in a sequencing run. Sequence should be reported in uppercase letters

seq quality check.description: Indicate if the sequence has been called by automatic systems (none) or undergone a manual editing procedure (e.g. by inspecting the raw data or chromatograms). Applied only for sequences that are not submitted to SRA or DRA e.g. none or manually edited

sop.description: Standard operating procedures used in assembly and/or annotation of genomes, metagenomes or environmental sequences

cloneStrain.description: Name of the individual DNA clone

cloningDate.description: Date when the DNA cloning was carried out

cloningMethod.description: Method or protocol used for DNA cloning

cloningStaff.description: Person or Institution who performed the cloning

plasmid.description: Name of Plasmid used for sequencing

lib_const_meth.description: Library construction method used for clone libraries

lib_reads_seqd.description: Total number of clones sequenced from the library

lib_screen.description: Specific enrichment or screening methods applied before and/or after creating clone libraries in order to select a specific group of sequences

lib_size.description: Total number of clones in the library prepared for the project

lib_vector.description: Cloning vector type(s) used in construction of libraries

identifier.description: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

DNAThreshold.description: Fragment size of the ladder you choose as a standard to measure the percentage of your DNA size, at or above threshold fragment size from ladder

gelBuffer.description: Buffer used to make your gel and buffer in which you run the gel. The gel should be made with the same buffer in which it is run

gelLadder.description: A Gel Ladder is a combination of various known-length fragments of DNA or RNA used to measure DNA or RNA fragments of unknown lengths.

gelStain.description: Type of gel stain used. Gel stain is a substance that binds to DNA and fluoresces under ultraviolet (UV) light.

gelStainConcentration.value: 5ul of 10,000x into 50 ml of TBE buffer

percentAboveThreshold.value: 10%, 35%, 50%, 80%. Usually a protocol considers 50% of fragments ≥ 9KB to be high genomic quality
percentAboveThreshold.description: Percent of your DNA at or above the size of the threshold

stainingMethod.value: Precast stain; Post stain; Stain in loading buffer
stainingMethod.description: Method used for staining gels, either precast-adding stain to your gel before casting; post stain-staining your gel after running; stain in loading buffer-adding the stain to the loading buffer

disposition.description: The current state of a specimen with respect to the collection identified in collectionCode or collectionID. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary.

blocked.description: Sample or specimen data can not be ordered/loaned in general, but are visible via portals.

blockedUntil.description: Sample or specimen data can not be ordered/loaned until the given date, but are visible via portals

loanConditions.value: for non-commercial institutions only; only with permission of material supplier
loanConditions.description: Sample can be ordered under certain conditions, that are described here

loanDate.description: Date when loan has been sent by the lender.

loanDestination.description: Name of person and/or organization the unit was sent to. Person/Institution who received the material.

loanIdentifier.description: The unique institutional loan number to uniquely identify a specimen on loan

receivedFrom.value: e.g. lender or recipient of a strain, sample, specimen etc.
receivedFrom.description: Name of person and/or organization the unit was received from. Person/Institution who authorized the loan of the material. From the perspective of the owner of the material, this type of loan is incoming.

DNADNAHybridization.description: Result of DNA-DNA hybridization, e.g. strain: measurement value percentage

DNAMeltingPoint.description: result of melting temperature (Tm) analysis, e.g. measurement value unit

materialSampleType.value: tissue, culture strain, specimen, DNA, RNA, Protein, environmental sample
materialSampleType.description: Classification of kind of physical sample in addition to BasisOfRecord/RecordBasis and Preparation Type.

methodDeterminationConcentrationAndRatio.description: Description of method used for concentration measurement (DNA)

methodDeterminationWeight.description: Description of method used for weight measurement

quality.description: Sample quality estimation based on parameters described at QualityRemarks

qualityCheckDate.description: Date of quality check (e.g. Nanodrop measurement (DNA))

qualityRemarks.description: Description of methods and parameters defining low, medium or high quality of a sample

ratioOfAbsorbance260_230.description: Ratio of absorbance at 260 nm and 230 nm assessing DNA purity (mostly secondary measure, indicates mainly EDTA, carbohydrates, phenol), (DNA samples only)

ratioOfAbsorbance260_280.description: Ratio of absorbance at 280 nm and 230 nm assessing DNA purity (mostly secondary measure, indicates mainly EDTA, carbohydrates, phenol), (DNA samples only)

sampleDesignation.description: Additional lab or project numbers used for the DNA or tissue sample.

estimated_size.description: The estimated size of the genome prior to sequencing. Of particular importance in the sequencing of (eukaryotic) genome which could remain in draft form for a long or unspecified period.

samp_size.description: Amount or size of sample (volume, mass or area) that was collected

permitStatus.value: Permit available , Permit not required , Permit not available , Unknown Material collected after 2014-10-12 cannot be in "Unknown" permit status!
permitStatus.description: Information about the presence, absence or other basic status of permits associated with the sample(s).

permitStatusQualifier.value: "no national requirement for a permit at date of access", "officially authorized illegal holder", "collected on private land", "pre-Nagoya"
permitStatusQualifier.description: Description of why a certain permit was not required or why Permit Status is unknown

permitText.description: The text of a permit related to the gathering/shipping or further details

permitType.description: A permit is a document that allows someone to take an action that otherwise would not be allowed.

associatedReferences.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers (publication, bibliographic reference, global unique identifier, URI) of literature associated with the Occurrence.

preparationMaterials.value: for DNA: DNeasy blood and tissue kit, CTAB;
preparationMaterials.description: Materials and chemicals used in the preparation of the specimen, tissue, DNA or RNA sample

preparationProcess.description: Process used in preparing the specimen or sample, can also be used to describe Phage/Plasmid propagation, Process used in extracting the DNA/RNA; adaptions made; SPREC code

fragmentLength.description: Length of fragments (on average or precise)

sequencingMethod.description: Method or protocol used to generate the DNA sequences/reads
